title: Establish the current hosted-model baseline

status.capability_ready: evaluation tooling only; no product capability or flag
status.baseline_measurement: not_run: rubric workflow-release-v1 is proposed; no admin profile export, evaluation key or spend authorization yet

design.checkpoint: UI-35; no visual changes in Q-01

ownership.independent_reviewer: pending; Lapo coordinates technical review and shared-file integration

behavior: Every hosted run needs a dated spend authorization for its profile and split; requests and reported tokens are checked before each POST, and a successful response without usage stops the run.

A held-out run also needs the plan's unmodified admin export (GET /api/llm/profiles, GET /api/llm/models) and a frozen release rubric; otherwise not_run with every reason, exit 2, no provider request.

The admin export resolves plan, profile, high slot and upstream model; a mismatched intendedModel is refused; the profile revision is a fingerprint of the resolved profile and declared proxy fallbacks.
Hosted requests are pinned to uj-high; any other alias is refused before sending and recorded on the row.
Report groups keep every scheduled task in the denominator, with one disposition per row from structured fields and Wilson 95% intervals for every rate.
--mode baseline writes a sanitized report judged against the frozen rubric and refuses smoke, plan, development, unpinned or mismatched runs.

migration: None. No schema, data or production behavior change; new evaluation row fields are optional.
rollback: Revert the Q-01 commit. Older run directories remain readable.
limitations: No paid hosted evaluation was run; the baseline is not_run.
Per-request upstream routing is not verifiable from the brain; the proxy spend log is the authority.
The existing held-out set (10 supported, 2 negative tasks) is below the proposed 40 and 20 minimum; verdicts read insufficient_sample until Q-02 adds tasks.
The hosted provider's error rewrite already prevents a fallback to uj-medium; the alias pin makes that a guarantee rather than fixing a live defect.

An admin with llm.view exports /api/llm/profiles and /api/llm/models and names each plan's profile key.
One evaluation account and key per plan.
